tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Terminal background behind every pane. The app never paints a solid fill over the user's terminal background except here, when it owns the full screen.

tokens.name: pane
tokens.usage: Inside of a pane (agent list, diff, PR). One step up from ground.

tokens.name: pane-raised
tokens.usage: Header bar, status bar, hovered/cursor row in an unfocused pane.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Background of the cursor row in the FOCUSED pane. Always paired with a ▌ marker in accent at column 0.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Box-drawing borders of unfocused panes and column rules. Decorative only: never carries meaning (below 3:1 on purpose).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, pane and pane-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, paths, token counts, key labels. ≥4.5:1 on pane in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Empty progress track (░), line numbers in diffs, placeholder dots. Decorative / non-essential only — fails 4.5:1 by design.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Focus: the focused pane's border and title, the cursor marker ▌, active key hint, links. The only brand colour; never used for a status.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text set on an accent fill (inverted key caps, the mode chip).

tokens.name: status-running
tokens.usage: Agent is working: spinner glyph, filled progress blocks, 'running' label. Paired with the braille spinner.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Agent finished, checks passed, PR approved. Paired with ✓.

tokens.name: status-failed
tokens.usage: Agent errored, checks failed, changes requested. Paired with ✗.

tokens.name: status-waiting
tokens.usage: Agent needs a human: permission prompt, question, review. The one status that should pull the eye. Paired with ◆.

tokens.name: status-paused
tokens.usage: Agent paused or queued. Paired with ‖ (paused) or ○ (queued).

tokens.name: diff-add-bg
tokens.usage: Background of an added line in the diff view.

tokens.name: diff-add-ink
tokens.usage: Text and + sign of an added line, on diff-add-bg.

tokens.name: diff-add-word
tokens.usage: Word-level highlight inside an added line.

tokens.name: diff-del-bg
tokens.usage: Background of a removed line in the diff view.

tokens.name: diff-del-ink
tokens.usage: Text and − sign of a removed line, on diff-del-bg.

tokens.name: diff-del-word
tokens.usage: Word-level highlight inside a removed line.

tokens.name: diff-hunk-bg
tokens.usage: Background of a hunk header row (@@ -12,7 +12,9 @@).

tokens.name: diff-hunk-ink
tokens.usage: Text of a hunk header row, on diff-hunk-bg.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Docs, splash and cover only. Never inside the TUI.

styles.name: pane-title
styles.usage: Pane titles set into the top border. Written in capitals in the source string; accent when focused, ink-muted otherwise.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Every row of the TUI. One row = 18px in HTML mockups = one terminal line.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Agent names, PR titles, the selected value. Terminal bold — use sparingly, max one bold run per row.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Diff and log content. Same metrics as body so code and chrome align on the cell grid.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: j/k move  ⏎ open  d diff  p pr  ? help
styles.usage: HTML mockups only, for dense key bars. In a real terminal there is one size; use ink-muted instead.

tokens.name: space-half
tokens.usage: Half a cell. HTML mockups only — terminals cannot render it.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: One column (≈1ch at 13px). Gap between glyph and label; inner pane padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Two columns. Gap between columns in a row (name │ status │ task).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Three columns. Gutter between side-by-side panes.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Four columns. Outer margin of docs and mockups.

tokens.name: row-1
tokens.usage: One terminal row. Vertical rhythm for every list, diff and bar.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default. Status bar, header bar, diff rows, progress cells — terminals are square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Pane frames in HTML mockups (stands in for ╭╮╰╯ rounded box-drawing).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Key caps and chips in docs only.
